name: MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.CAR.trace_transportedFlag
title: Shell matching fixes the trace of transported flags

content.assumptions:
Let $A$ be the completed CAR algebra with matrix stages $M_{2^n}(\mathbb C)$ embedded by $a\mapsto a\otimes I_2$. Write $f_n$ for the image of the first diagonal matrix unit, $p_n=f_n-f_{n+1}$, and $\omega$ for the root state characterized by $\omega(\iota_n(a))=a_{00}$ on each stage, where $\iota_n$ is its canonical embedding.

Index chosen pure-state Gelfand-Naimark-Segal (GNS) representations by their unitary-equivalence classes $j\in I$, with root index $o$ and representative states $\varphi_j$.

A fixed shell family consists of complex-linear unital star automorphisms $\alpha_j$ and elements $w_{j,n}\in A$ satisfying $\varphi_j(\alpha_j(a))=\omega(a)$, $w_{j,n}^*w_{j,n}=\alpha_j(p_n)$ and $w_{j,n}w_{j,n}^*=p_n$.

At the root, $\alpha_o$ is the identity and $w_{o,n}=p_n$.

The functional $\tau$ is the normalized CAR trace defined in [the trace construction](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CAR/Trace.lean#L62-L64). In particular $\tau(f_n)=2^{-n}$. The same family and the same automorphism $\alpha_j$ are used for all values of $n$.
content.conclusion: Transported flags and root flags have the same trace at each level. This supplies the decaying scalar values needed to estimate their action on vectors implementing the trace.
content.display_title: Shell matching fixes the trace of transported flags
content.lean_realization_notes: No new automorphism is chosen and trace-invariance of arbitrary automorphisms is not assumed. The proof uses the exact support identities of the given links and finite induction; it does not infer that the projections themselves converge in operator norm.
content.natural_language_statement: For the completed CAR algebra with normalized trace $\tau$ and a fixed shell family, the transported projection $f_{j,n}=\alpha_j(f_n)$ satisfies $\tau(f_{j,n})=2^{-n}$ for every index $j$ and every $n\geq0$. Here $f_n$ is the root projection at the matrix stage of size $2^n$.
content.one_sentence_role: Recovers exact trace values from the initial and final supports of shell links.

proof_steps.text: Use $w_{j,n}^*w_{j,n}=f_{j,n}-f_{j,n+1}$ and $w_{j,n}w_{j,n}^*=f_n-f_{n+1}$ in the trace identity.
At $n=0$ both flags are $1$. If their traces agree at $n$, equality of the successive differences gives agreement at $n+1$.
At stage $n$, the root projection has exactly one diagonal entry equal to $1$. Dividing its matrix trace by $2^n$ gives the stated value.

content.proof_summary: For each shell link, traciality gives $\tau(w_{j,n}^*w_{j,n})=\tau(w_{j,n}w_{j,n}^*)$. Its support identities turn this into $\tau(f_{j,n})-\tau(f_{j,n+1})=\tau(f_n)-\tau(f_{n+1})$. Both flags start at $1$, so induction forces equal trace values at every level. The root value is the normalized trace of a rank-one diagonal matrix projection.
